title: 迪士尼确认Disney+将直播2027超级碗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I guess the surprise element is that they are streaming it on Disney Plus as opposed to ESPN.
segments.zh: 令人意外的是，他们选择在Disney+而非ESPN上流媒体播出。

segments.en: So we've already seen a lot of different streaming platforms, stream the Super Bowl, Peacock did it this year, which is the streaming service from NBC.
segments.zh: 我们已经看到许多流媒体平台转播超级碗，今年Peacock（NBC的流媒体服务）也进行了转播。

segments.en: We know that 2B, which belongs to Fox, did it in 2025.
segments.zh: 我们知道，属于福克斯的2B在2025年也转播了。

segments.en: So nothing new here. I mean, streaming has now just become a part of the overall television conversation here.
segments.zh: 所以这并不新鲜。流媒体如今已成为整体电视讨论的一部分。

segments.en: And it's obviously with such a massive event like the Super Bowl, it becomes a huge subscription acquisition, subscriber acquisition event as well as a great retention event.
segments.zh: 显然，像超级碗这样的大型活动，成为巨大的订阅获取和用户留存事件。

segments.en: But I think what this piece of news, Alexis, what it tells us about Disney's ongoing strategy is that they're really looking to convert Disney Plus,
segments.zh: 但我认为，Alexis，这条新闻告诉我们迪士尼的持续战略是，他们真的希望将Disney+转变为

segments.en: which is really more your platform for some of the old cartoon movies and just their regular movies,
segments.zh: 这个平台原本更多是播放老卡通电影和常规电影、

segments.en: their animation titles, but they're now looking to make that kind of the front door to the entire Disney ecosystem.
segments.zh: 动画片，但现在他们希望将其打造成整个迪士尼生态系统的入口。

segments.en: And what better way to do it than use the Super Bowl, the biggest sporting event in the United States.
segments.zh: 还有什么比利用美国最大的体育赛事超级碗更好的方式呢？

segments.en: Exactly. And ESPN, which we know is owned by Disney, this will be their first Super Bowl production.
segments.zh: 没错。我们知道ESPN属于迪士尼，这将是他们的首次超级碗制作。

segments.en: But I guess my question would be, if you can see the Super Bowl on a number of different platforms, what is Disney giving the viewer, the pain, subscriber?
segments.zh: 但我的问题是，如果超级碗能在多个平台观看，迪士尼给观众和订阅者带来什么价值？

segments.en: Where's the value for the viewer and watching the Super Bowl here?
segments.zh: 观众在这里看超级碗的价值在哪里？

segments.en: What's sort of the value proposition that Disney is representing?
segments.zh: 迪士尼所代表的价值主张是什么？
